changelog:
- Initial release of google-search-serp skill.
- Extracts Google Search results page (SERP) data, including organic results, paid ads, related searches, People Also Ask questions, AI Overview text, and total result count.
- Operates only on already loaded Google search pages; no authentication bypass.
- Provides detailed usage instructions, URL parameterization, error handling for CAPTCHA, and pagination guidance.
- Outlines field outputs and known limitations, such as AI Overview availability and Google anti-bot challenges.
- Includes efficiency tips for batch keyword processing, error recovery, and session management.
summary: Extracts Google Search results page (SERP) data including organic results, paid ads, related searches, People Also Ask questions, AI Overview text, and total result count from google.com.
